crossCheck.note: Independent second source, close but not identical to sunrisesunset.io, kept as a corroborating range rather than reconciled to one figure.

annualTotal2026.note: 2026 is not a leap year. Average day length derived from this total divided by daysInYear, not entered as a separate hand rounded figure.

summerSolstice2026.note: Day of year in a non leap year (31+28+31+30+31+21).

notFetchable.note: timeanddate.com and gaisma.com blocked automated fetching in this research pass (robots.txt or 403).

monthlyTotalDaylight2026.unit: hours:minutes total daylight for the month
